protocol.development_plan: Original train/validation, and original patient3fold seed20261125 with stopping-group seeds20261124+fold. All four separate B/L geometries and plans frozen before anyhead fit.
protocol.hypothesis: Direct normalL residual and B-query attention did not pass M7 gates. Small residual/M7 mixtures passed development and await patient confirmation. Test a different structural hypothesis: matching spatial B/L low-rank codes by elementwise products may express complementary cross-backbone co-occurrence that unary additive evidence cannot. Use identical-parameter additive controls; this uses established factorized bilinear pooling and is not a global methodological novelty claim.
protocol.architecture: Unchanged original normalB attention/MLP. Separate fit-normal-patient B/L PCA32. B1536/L2048 each share LayerNorm+Linear->rank16/32+tanh across four streams. Pair same-position codes by product, or sum/sqrt2 with identical modules. Average9 regional pairs before shared LayerNorm(rank); normalize global/mid/dispersion codes similarly. Concatenate4rank,zero-init Linear->256,.1residual before original hidden dropout. The matched additive regional mean is invariant to independent L regional permutation; the product is sensitive to B/L pair alignment. Joint permutation invariance retained.

protocol.selection: Highest qualifying original CV with CV strictly>M7 and validation>=M7 frozen before two unusedpatient3fold repeats. Higher sixfoldmeanF1 and joint pairedpatient95%lowerendpoint>0 versus EACHofM7/M6/M5/fixedGaussian. No automatic external evaluation.
